text:
support-ops: :rotating_light: Multiple customer escalations and SLO alerts. Since ~12:00 PDT we're seeing an uptick in 5xxs and gateway timeouts from hosted inference. Several support tickets opened. Error rate at gateway ~8% (baseline ~0.2%).
alert-bot: [ALERT] hosted-api.gateway.high_5xx_rate triggered at 2026-03-17T19:00:12Z - 5xx rate 8.3% over 5m
maria: copying in SRE. any deploys/flags around 11:50-12:10?
deploy-bot: canary rollout 2419000000 completed: config change `enable_precise_batching=true` rolled to canary (10%) at 2026-03-17T18:58:41Z; no errors flagged by automated smoke.
kevin: from support: 3 enterprise customers reporting repeated 502/504 + long tail timeouts, and one flagged unusually high token/billing counts due to retries. They see client retries spiking.
liam: quick repro from our side: 
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwdx-large","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
> HTTP/2 502
< server: redwood-gateway
< x-upstream-error: connection-reset-by-peer
```
liam: gateway logs show `upstream reset` on the serving fleet for many short requests, but CPU on serving nodes is fine. KV cache misses spiked.
maria: hypothesis: `enable_precise_batching` changed batching semantics causing many tiny requests to be batched wrongly, pushing special-case paths and triggering transient upstream connection overloads. Also seeing auth header trimming in a tiny subset (missing auth on retry) which leads to 401->retry->502 loops.
nashley: suggest immediate emergency rollback of the canary flag to 0% on hosted. Also coordinate with Support for customer credits.
maria: agreed. I'll coordinate rollback. Steps: 1) flip canary flag `enable_precise_batching=false` for canary group; 2) trigger fast redeploy of gateway route config; 3) monitor 5xx and retries for next 10m. Who can run the flag flip?
deploy-bot: run command `./orchctl flag set --env hosted --name enable_precise_batching --pct 0 --reason "emergency rollback 5xx spike"`
kevin: letting customer success know and opening CS ticket templates for credits. Billing-bot: flagged a potential billing anomaly for acct `acme-corp` showing +120% token usage in 30m.
maria: rolling back now (calling the command).
maria: rollback applied at 2026-03-17T19:03:05Z per deploy-bot. Canaries now at 0%.
liam: initial metrics: gateway 5xx down from 8.3% to 1.1% in ~2m after rollback. Latency p95 improving. KV miss rate normalizing.
kevin: confirmed with acme-corp they see errors decreasing. CS will draft credits and timeline.
nashley: action items: postmortem runbook, determine why smoke didn't catch this (add synthetic exercise for tiny-batch path), add telemetry for auth header trimming on retries.
maria: creating incident and assigning postmortem. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre. Closing thread once postmortem created.
support-ops: thanks all — will update affected tickets and close customer escalations once CS confirms. :heart:
